name: Horticulture Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (nature) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Green Thumb (Ex)

You gain the green empathy ability, as the treesinger archetype of the druid class, using your ranks in Knowledge (nature) as your effective treesinger level. (You can use inspiration on this check, but not for free.) In addition, you gain a +1 bonus on all saving throws against plant-based attacks for every 4 ranks you possess in Knowledge (nature).

This includes traps and hazards from fungal and plant sources, all fungal and plant-based toxins, and all extraordinary, spell-like, or supernatural attacks from creatures with the plant type.

Associated Technique
Tricking Technique (Ex)

By using various nettles, seeds, vines, and other plant byproducts at your disposal, you gain a +1 bonus to your CMB on any dirty trick combat maneuver checks made against a target you have studied with this ability, and you never provoke attacks of opportunity while using a dirty trick combat maneuver against that target. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +7 at 18th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Bomb Fruit (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Green Thumb study ability, Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks, scholar level 3rd.

You have learned to cultivate explosive, acorn-sized nuts from rare flora. You can have one such plant at a time, which must be planted or potted in natural soil. The plant weighs 1 lb. if potted. It must receive air, water, and at least one hour of sunlight daily or it will become dormant until these conditions are met again. If destroyed, you can grow a new plant at a cost of 500 gp in one week’s time. The plant yields a number of nuts every morning at dawn equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence bonus; these nuts will not grow under anyone’s care but yours.

The nuts are only ripe for 24 hours. If eaten, they are extremely bitter and mildly poisonous, inducing the nauseated condition for 1d4 rounds per nut consumed (Fort negates; DC 12 + 2 per nut consumed). However, while ripe they can also be thrown as alchemical weapons.

When they hit, they create a mini-explosion, dealing fire damage equal to 1d6 per 3 ranks that you have in Knowledge (nature). If they strike an unattended flammable object, they may also cause that object to catch fire. Bomb fruit only cause damage on a direct hit; they do not cause splash damage.

Cultivation (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Green Thumb study ability, scholar level 5th.

You can use your choice of diminish plant, entangle, goodberry, or plant growth once per day as a spell-like ability by expending 1 point of inspiration. You can use a different ability each day, and can choose which ability to use at the time of casting. The caster level is equal to your ranks in Knowledge (nature). If the spell-like ability is cast as a ritual (requiring an additional 10 minutes of casting time), it does not expend inspiration, but you can still only use cultivation once per day. When you reach 13 ranks in Knowledge (nature), you can use cultivation twice per day.
